sara_infra: FYI -- since the kernel roll (3:30UTC) we're seeing intermittent gRPC stream stalls for long-lived pod-to-pod streams between node-17 and node-19 in ap-northeast. Streams don't fully drop but stall for ~60-120s, then recover. Only affects large payloads (video chunks). :thinking_face:

ben: seeing the same. spike in retransmits on node-19, and a bunch of TCP zero-window on the server side. quick ss dump: `ESTAB  0      0      10.0.17.8:52344    10.0.19.2:9000  timer:(keepalive,23min,0)`

dmitri: can you paste a tcpdump? specifically looking for IP fragments or ICMP frag-needed messages. also any SR-IOV VF changes this morning?

sara_infra: grabbing tcpdump from node-17 (filtered):
```
15:12:01.123456 IP 10.0.17.8.52344 > 10.0.19.2.9000: Flags [P.], seq 1:1441, ack 1, win 64240, length 1440
15:12:01.123789 IP 10.0.17.8 > 10.0.19.2: frag 1480@1480
15:12:01.124000 IP 10.0.17.8.52344 > 10.0.19.2.9000: Flags [P.], seq 1441:2881, ack 1, win 64240, length 1440
```

sara_infra: there are explicit fragment frames. looks like packets are getting split mid-path.

ben: that points to MTU mismatch somewhere in the path. i pulled `ip link` on both nodes:
```
node-17: cilium_vxlan mtu 1450 qlen 1000
node-17: eth0 mtu 1500 qlen 1000
node-19: eth0 mtu 1500 qlen 1000
node-19: sriov0 vf0 mtu 9000 qlen 1000
```

ben: note node-19 has SR-IOV VF with jumbo (9000) while the overlay vxlan is 1450 on node-17. late-bind VF assignment from yesterday's provisioning script might be the culprit.

mira: could be host-device mode + VF MTU mismatch w/ Cilium host-device. If host has jumbo MTU and overlay/peer expects 1450, kernel will fragment when sending from VF-backed pod to overlay-backed pod on another node.

dmitri: quick mitigation options: (a) clamp MTU on VF to 1450, (b) disable TSO/GSO/GRO on the problematic interface, or (c) enable tcp_mtu_probing.

sara_infra: trying (b) now on node-19 for the offending interface: `ethtool -K sriov0 tso off gso off gro off`

infra-bot: deploy job infra/mtu-clamp-daemonset started by @sara_infra — rolling to nodes with label gpu=TRUE (batch size 5). :gear:

ben: after disabling offloads i see fewer fragments in tcpdump and streams resuming. still want to fix config so it doesn't come back when we reprovision.

mira: long-term: update provisioning to set VF MTU to cluster-overlay-mtu (1450) during SR-IOV attach. Also update Cilium DaemonSet to explicitly set `mtu: 1450` and add an e2e check to the node-setup job.

dmitri: sysctl tweak that helps while we roll: `sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_mtu_probing=1` — this helps endpoints discover path MTU and avoid giant segments. Not a substitute for consistent MTU though.

sara_infra: action items:
- ben to push hotfix daemonset to clamp VF MTU to 1450 and roll GPU nodes (in progress)
- dmitri to add TSO/GSO guard to bootstrap scripts 
- mira to update provisioning pipeline to enforce VF MTU and add validation test
- infra-oncall to monitor for 2h and escalate if stalls persist

ben: patch applied to canary nodes (node-19, node-21). so far 45m with no stall for the large ingestion job. :thumbsup:

mira: created PR for provisioning and Cilium config, added unit test. tagging @sara_infra for review.

sara_infra: nice work. leaving the thread open until the rollout completes. will post a postmortem if we see recurrence. :eyes:
